text: Security is essential in web development. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between the user and the server. This protects sensitive information like passwords. Second, authentication checks that users are who they claim to be. Strong passwords and two-factor authentication help a lot. Third, validate all input from users. Never trust data from forms, because attackers may send harmful code. Common vulnerabilities include SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS), which happen when input is not checked properly. By following these basic rules, developers can build safer websites and protect both users and data from online threats.
